cascadeInspection: Independent review verified the authenticated Header10 anatomy and inspected the DOM, CSS cascade, form enhancement, all seven cache-busted captures, and responsive geometry. One labelled full-svh hero contains one flexible top cover image and one contiguous content-sized bottom surface band. The band uses Ren10 center/switcher/stack primitives to place the h1 left and description/email/legal content right when wide, then stacks in source order narrowly. The form owns exactly one visible label, one native email input, one submit button, one polite status, and one real terms destination. Pristine state has no error, aria-invalid, or confirmation; invalid submit focuses the field and exposes its wired error; valid input clears the error; valid submit stays inline; JavaScript-disabled submission and terms destinations resolve. Primitive Zero margins are intentionally neutralized only where the full-height composition requires it. No framework, Shadow DOM, raw flex/grid skeleton, duplicate action, pseudo-element artifact, overflow, hardcoded chromatic color, primitive palette token, navigation, logo, video, scrim, or second CTA exists. Light, dark, reduced-motion, tablet, mobile, and no-JavaScript captures are aligned and unclipped.

controls.description: Authenticated complete Relume Header10 source was fetched independently and matches the persisted factual brief.
The public implementation contains no protected source, copied classes, dependencies, asset URLs, or default content.
Reference, mapped, and genuine missing-page RED evidence validate in the green packet lineage.
All implementation work stays inside the declared block, focused spec, and Header10 packet directory.
Seven cache-busted PNG/JSON states trace reviewed commit d4f05cc1cab57959f7b4d3393d374b7032df95a0.
Exactly one labelled full-svh hero root exists.
Exactly one flexible top media region contains one owned cover image with intrinsic dimensions and meaningful alt text.
Exactly one contiguous bottom band contains one h1 and one description.
The support column owns exactly one visible email label/input and one submit CTA.
Exactly one legal line follows the form and contains one real terms link.
No navigation, brand, logo, video, scrim, dialog, menu, CTA pair, or extra form action exists.
Implementation is vanilla HTML/CSS/JS in Light DOM with real semantic elements.
Foundation, full component bundle, field enhancement, button, and link usage match their documented contracts.
ren-cover, ren-center, ren-switcher, and ren-stack own the page and form skeleton.
No bespoke display flex/grid skeleton duplicates an available Ren10 layout primitive.
Consumer CSS uses semantic, component, typography, width, and spacing tokens without hardcoded chroma or primitive palette tokens.
Primitive Zero native margins and ren-cover child cascade are deliberately neutralized without breaking component ownership.
The image flexes to the viewport remainder and meets the content band without gap or overlap.
Wide layout places heading left and support content right with aligned starts.
Narrow layout stacks heading before support content, and the form stacks field before submit.
The form becomes one bottom-aligned row when sufficient width is available.
Widths 320, 390, 767, 768, and 1280 remain full-height, contiguous, readable, and free of horizontal overflow.
Email, submit, and legal link have accessible names, logical focus order, and visible focus in light and dark themes.
All interactive targets meet the 44px minimum.
Pristine validation exposes no error, aria-invalid state, or confirmation before interaction.
Invalid submit focuses the email, reveals a corrective wired error, and valid input clears the state.
Valid enhanced submission produces a polite inline confirmation without navigation.
Axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA, reduced motion, native email validity, no-JavaScript form action, and terms destination pass.
Desktop light and dark captures preserve the flexible image and coherent two-column band.
Tablet and mobile light/dark captures are aligned, readable, and unclipped.
Reduced-motion and JavaScript-disabled captures preserve the same complete hierarchy without visual artifacts.
Intentional Ren10 typography, spacing, control, and theme differences preserve the Relume anatomy and function.
Focused Playwright suite passes 28 of 28 tests across light and dark projects; axe checks are clean.
npm run lint exits zero with no errors; only pre-existing repository warnings remain.
npm run agent:check and the explicit full eval run both exit zero.
Workflow validation, 19/26/8 contract counts, stale-reference scan, capture lineage, allowed-files audit, and git diff checks pass.

applicableEvalsChecklist: All applicable RenDS self-check items pass. The block uses a single native email form rather than ren-form as required by the form contract's single-input routing; field, button, link, Primitive Zero, token, layout, focus, validation, no-JavaScript, reduced-motion, browser, lint, eval, and workflow controls were verified. Dialog, migration, and new-component lint-exemption items are not applicable.
